controls: Capabilities receipt must bind HTTP Date, fetch time, final URL and XML SHA.
GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage endpoints must each resolve uniquely with approved methods.
Pinned coverage must advertise the expected grid coverage subtype rather than an image-style or hillshade product.
DescribeCoverage boundedBy and native envelope must unambiguously use EPSG:27700.
Grid low/high indices, axis labels and dimension count must agree before subset requests.
Offset vectors must prove orthogonal one-metre grid spacing and expected axis directions.
Range type must expose one usable elevation field with metre unit and no ambiguous alternate bands.
Each request must bind exact unpadded polygon bounds, padded bounds and geometry SHA.
Padding must be the exact finite two-metre contract and applied once in EPSG:27700.
Canonical ordered query bytes and SHA must be recorded before transport.
Production request must not silently route through unapproved proxy environment variables.
Connect, read and total deadlines must be independently bounded and included in failure receipts.
Accepted response requires HTTP 200, approved GeoTIFF media type, bounded length and SHA-256.
Responses must be screened for XML/OGC exception payloads even when the server labels them as binary.
Content-Disposition filename must be optional, safe and consistent with a TIFF response.
Opened raster must contain exactly one elevation band.
CRS, affine transform and all raster bounds must be finite and non-degenerate.
Pixel width and height must equal one metre within a strict documented tolerance.
Affine transform must be north-up and unrotated unless an explicitly supported grid contract is proven.
Nodata metadata, mask band and finite-value screening must agree for every sampled cell.
Primary extrema must use explicit pixel-centre point-in-polygon membership, not Rasterio Bresenham side effects.
Every accepted cell must retain row, column, centre coordinates, raw value and identity hash.
Each target needs a positive bounded strict-centre pixel count and diagnostic mask disagreement count.
Min, max and quantiles must be computed from finite float64 physical values before presentation rounding.
Quantile method and NumPy version must be pinned and included in the sample receipt.
Rows must identify the exact cells producing raw minimum and maximum values.
Each row must bind canonical request SHA, response TIFF SHA and exact HMLR geometry SHA.
Sample output must enforce an exact schema and reject unknown safety-critical fields.
EA output must include one run_id with stage start/end timestamps and bounded duration.
Transport, parse, sampling or timeout failure must quarantine partial TIFF and prior stable output.
Current EA payload must bind slot, task, attempt, continuation and the same run_id as the numeric gate.
Preserved evidence must bind expected slot, rows, HMLR IDs, metric definition and immutable source SHA.
Duplicate preserved rows must fail rather than silently overwrite dictionary entries.
Current parcel_id must exactly equal parcel_<row_no> and match HMLR and candidate stages.
Current payload must provide raw unrounded extrema fields; rounded-only samples cannot pass.
Tolerance comparison must use raw max-minus-min and raw preserved difference before display rounding.
Tolerance must equal the exact task contract 0.001m and reject looser command-line overrides.
Median elevation must be finite and lie within raw minimum and maximum.
Preserved and current confidence values must be finite and at least the required 96 percent.
Each row must include a valid 64-hex GeoTIFF SHA propagated from the EA response.
Each row must include a valid canonical request SHA propagated from the EA request.
Each row must include the exact fresh HMLR geometry SHA used for sampling.
Joined rows must be emitted in exact target-row order.
Inputs must remain stable and output must be atomically published with final SHA.
Numeric gate must receipt exact command arguments and executable hashes for every stage.
Every accepted stage output must be tied to a current-run zero exit code.
Accepted stage files must be created after the current gate start and inside its run directory.
Each stage output SHA must remain stable while parsed and joined.
Per-stage and global wall-clock deadlines must prevent indefinite PENDING.
Timeout must terminate all descendants and verify no stage process or open partial output remains.
HMLR, EA, metric and Terrain rows must join one-to-one on row, parcel and HMLR ID.
Terrain50 may start only after the raw current height metric gate passes.
Port 8012 verification may start only after all three current Terrain50 screens are accepted.
Final receipt must publish a complete ordered SHA chain for inputs, commands and outputs.
Any failed current stage must leave current candidate promotion and business writes at zero.
OS products response must have the exact documented structure and reject ambiguous product records.
Selected Terrain50 product version/date must be recorded and consistent with the current annual July release.
Download selection must bind exact TQ area and reject national, contour or alternate-resolution packages.
Selected item must be the exact ASCII Grid and GML grid supply, not substring or contour formats.
Resolver output must hash the exact product/download JSON item that supplied the URL.
Downloaded archive byte count, final size and SHA must agree with bounded transport metadata.
Outer and nested ZIP members must all pass CRC validation.
Unicode, case and separator normalization must detect collisions and reject traversal or special files.
Resolved grid inputs must contain exactly one accepted grid for TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27.
ASCII header must contain each required semantic key exactly once with no duplicate aliases.
ncols and nrows must be strict integer 200.
cellsize must be finite and exactly 50 metres within strict tolerance.
xllcorner and yllcorner must equal the documented south-west origin of the named tile.
The data body must contain exactly 200 rows with exactly 200 numeric tokens each.
Every non-nodata token must parse deterministically as a finite decimal elevation.
NODATA declaration and observed nodata count must be recorded and applied consistently.
First data row must map to the north edge and west-to-east cell order.
GML external file reference must equal the selected ASC basename exactly.
GML grid envelope and sequence rule must agree with 200 by 200 cells.
GML origin and offset vectors must agree with ASC bounds and 50m centre semantics.
PRJ must be semantically equivalent to EPSG:27700 with metre axes.
Per-tile metadata must bind tile reference, product identity and flying date.
Sampled values must use unique tile-row-column identities with no repeated cell weighting.
Every all-touched cell must record polygon overlap area and fraction; sliver cells cannot silently dominate.
The 4.15m and 8.30m conservative screens must use raw current values before display rounding.
Every probe base must resolve to loopback and exact port 8012 after URL normalization.
HTTP server PID, start time, canonical commit and current run_id must be receipted.
Index, manifest, progress, operations, sources, examples and candidates must each return HTTP 200.
Required assets must not redirect and final normalized URLs must remain inside the slot base.
HTML and JSON assets need approved media types and deterministic UTF-8 charset semantics.
Content-Length when present must equal received bytes and every body must have a SHA-256 receipt.
Date, ETag or Last-Modified validators must prove all accepted assets belong to one serving epoch.
Manifest-declared operation, source and example counts must equal parsed assets.
Current child range must begin at prior end plus one and remain globally unique and contiguous.
Every operation row must use strict numeric ID, approved status/stage enums and bounded text.
Source rows must use approved official domains and finite confidence values within zero to one hundred.
Preserved numeric examples must be explicitly labelled evidence-only and never fresh current results.
A fresh numeric claim requires current coherent HMLR, EA, Terrain and web receipts.
latest, qa_latest, bundle, progress and page range must agree after remote readback.
Web acceptance must atomically publish and cannot reuse a previous PASS after any current probe failure.
One immutable run_id must bind slot, task, attempt, continuation and all four required receipts.
Preflight 015 and snapshot 016 must have coherent ordering, identities and remotely read back SHA values.
Restart 014 must prove exactly one daemon, fresh advancing heartbeat and exact claim identity.
Final 003 must contain three fresh EA/Terrain bindings and three accepted crosschecks from current bytes.
No-progress PENDING beyond fifteen minutes must transition once to guarded recovery with a deterministic receipt.
A failed safe retry must not loop; it must record RECOVERY_PARKED with the real technical cause.
Existing manual action must refresh current canonical metrics and receipt status without historical support inflation.
RESOLVED is allowed only after remote readback proves four coherent receipts and six current checks.
Bundle, progress, page, latest, qa and index updates must be remotely reread as one coherent child transaction.
Child staging must not mutate canonical operations manifest, ownership, business rows or final_ready.
